numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures for Q2 2026 (I12) shows total assets of EUR 2,714,309k (EUR 2.71B) and total equity of EUR 1,200,533k (EUR 1.20B) as at 30.06.26.

numerical_claims.claim: Net debt decreased to EUR 830 million from EUR 852 million at the end of 2025, and the net debt to EBITDA ratio improved to 3.3 times from 3.7 times.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures for Q2 2026 (I12) shows net debt of EUR 829,904k (EUR 830M) as at 30.06.26 vs EUR 851,582k (EUR 852M) as at 31.12.25. Net debt/EBITDA is 3.3x (2026) vs 3.7x (2025).

numerical_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents grew to EUR 253 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures for Q2 2026 (I12) and Note 3.1 (I25) show cash and cash equivalents of EUR 253,187k (EUR 253.2M) as at 30.06.26.

numerical_claims.claim: The group employed 6,890 people as of June 30, 2026
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures for Q2 2026 (I12) states 'Number of group employees 6 890' as at 30.06.26.

numerical_claims.claim: Infortar increased its ownership in Tallink Grupp to 68.76%
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026 - Changes in Group Structure (I8) states: 'In Q2 2026, Infortar acquired additional shares in Tallink Grupp, as a result of which its ownership in Tallink Group increased to 68.76%.'
